'''''Phymosia umbellata''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Malvaceae]]. It is native to Mexico and is cultivated as an ornamental plant.<ref name=GRIN>{{GRIN | accessdate=25 May 2011}}</ref>

This tropical [[evergreen]] shrub grows to {{cvt|3|m|ft|abbr=on}} in height, with cup shaped scarlet flowers produced mainly in summer.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/74142/phymosia-umbellata/details | title = ''Phymosia umbellata'' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 31 October 2022}}</ref>

In [[temperate climate|temperate]] areas it requires a warm, sheltered position.
